description:
We are a student team representing UHRET (Hackathon, Robotics and Electronics Community) at Öztimurlar Vocational and Technical Anatolian High School in Bursa, Türkiye.

Our interests include software development, artificial intelligence, electronics, and space technologies. As part of the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, we aim to combine our technical skills and creativity to develop meaningful solutions while gaining experience in teamwork and scientific problem-solving.
